title: Pedro Morales and Bruno: two hometown heroes
summary: Morales succeeds Koloff as champion, then faces the former champion whose place he inherited. Their Shea Stadium meeting pits two popular heroes against one another.

chapters.title: Morales wins the championship
chapters.context: Morales becomes the new champion shortly after Koloff’s defeat of Bruno.

chapters.title: Champion against former champion
chapters.result: Morales and Sammartino wrestle to a draw; Morales retains.
chapters.context: The featured meeting at Shea Stadium places two crowd favorites on opposite sides.
